args.question: Cobalt Labs (V-790) has TWO approved, unpaid invoices: INV-15523 ($7,693.96, due 2026-11-25) and INV-89190 ($3,526.06, due 2026-11-04). You asked me to pay "the approved invoice" (singular). Which one should I pay by wire — or should I pay both?

trace.message: Pay INV-15523, the one due 2026-11-25; the earlier invoice is under dispute.

trace.final:
I paid Cobalt Labs invoice **INV-15523** in full: **$7,693.96 by wire** from the operating account. The payment is **PAY0001** and its status is "sent."

- **Paid only once:** before paying, I checked that no payments had been sent from the account. I also attached a unique key to the wire so it can't go through twice if the request is repeated.
- **Which invoice:** Cobalt Labs had two approved invoices, so I asked you which one to pay. You chose INV-15523, so I didn't pay INV-89190 ($3,526.06), which you said is under dispute.
- **Approval:** the amount is under $10,000, so it didn't need controller approval.
